t: A six-core Linux board with an open PCIe slot for fast drives and cards.
steps: Look for the board at the PINE64 store or ameriDroid. Check stock first, as both showed sold out.
Get a 12 volt 3 amp barrel jack power supply and a heatsink or fan.
Get a microSD card or an eMMC module for the operating system.
Download a community Linux image for the RockPro64 from the Pine64 docs.
Write the image to the card with an image writing app.
Connect power, an HDMI screen, a keyboard and a network cable.
Follow the getting started page on the Pine64 docs site.
Try FreedomBox as a first project after updating the boot firmware in the SPI flash.
meta: Open Board. From $59.99. A few stores.
